name: Autocomplete 4xx
description: Turns the site 403/404 error-page fields into autocomplete widgets backed by a node/route search endpoint.
project_description: Autocomplete 4xx alters core's Basic site settings form (admin/config/system/site-information) so the 403 (access denied) and 404 (page not found) path fields become autocomplete widgets instead of plain text fields. Typing in either field queries a JSON endpoint that suggests matching node paths (by title) and, optionally, system route paths, so a site builder can pick an existing page for an error response without remembering its path. A settings form at admin/config/system/autocomplete_4xx controls what the suggestions include: system routes, parameterized routes, unpublished nodes, and a bundle filter limiting which content types are searched. The module requires no modules outside Drupal core and supports Drupal 10 and 11.
